retrieval_note: Initial Google request had a connection failure; urllib arXiv API and publisher/full-text access subsequently succeeded. Bing returned HTML with no parsed result entries. Initial guessed Raftery PDF URL returned 404; actual journal full text was subsequently found at PMC2895940. Crossref first result was a technical report, not the journal article; journal DOI verified from full text: 10.1198/TECH.2009.08104. An unrelated guessed arXiv ID was excluded after title verification.
